[[File:GamorreanGuard-EoD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Gamorrean guard with axe]]
The '''Gamorrean war ax''' or '''Gamorrean Battleaxe''' was a type of inert [[Axe/Legends|axe]] used mostly by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]]. What they lacked in subtlty, they more than made up for in very damaging blows.

==Behind the scenes==
The Gamorrean battleaxe was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' but it was removed from the final version of the game. As the weapon was still present in the game files, it could be obtained using cheat codes.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
